title: IVG Intense Salts Frozen Cherries 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Frozen Cherries delivers the ripe sweetness of juicy Cherries, contrasted by a frosty Ice layer for a refreshingly cool finish. The deep fruit base comes through clearly, while the Ice note adds balance and keeps the flavour tasting crisp. Formulated at a 50VG/50PG ratio, Frozen Cherries ensures a smooth draw, discreet vapour output, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, vape pens, and starter devices. As part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Frozen Cherries is a clear, fruit-led vape that combines sweetness and coolness in equal measure, ideal for vapers who enjoy Cherry flavours with an icy edge.
